# Workspace Instructions

This workspace contains a local Node/SQLite payroll portal for Maison Rotterdam. Keep the existing Express and SQLite setup unless the user asks for a different architecture.

- Keep all employee names and salary values fictional and label payroll values as illustrative.
- Do not introduce shared default credentials or present local-development behavior as production authentication or access control.
- Do not claim Moroccan payroll compliance; statutory calculations require qualified review.
- Preserve admin and employee role separation. Employees should only see their own record.
- Run the app with `npm run dev`; opening `index.html` directly does not provide API or authentication functionality.
